metadata.description: Polling for the 81-member Jharkhand Legislative Assembly began on Wednesday, November 13, with voters turning out in 43 assembly constituencies. According to Election Commission data, Jharkhand recorded a voter turnout of 64.86% by 5 pm. This election sees the JMM-led INDIA alliance facing off against the BJP-led NDA. Early indicators suggest the JMM may have a lead over the BJP in this first phase, but whether it can replicate its 2019 performance—when it swept 13 out of 14 seats in the Kolhan region—remains to be seen.
